technique_name: Write an article about climate change.
description: Climate change is one of the most pressing and urgent issues of the modern world. It is an ever-evolving environmental threat that threatens the planet's future, especially with regards to the natural environment that we as humans depend upon. Over the decades, the scientific community has recorded a consistent and steady rise in global temperatures that can only be attributed to the increasing concentrations of Greenhouse gases in the atmosphere due to our continued burning of fossil fuels.
